summary: TOYO Co., Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Tokyo-based solar manufacturer listed on Nasdaq, furnished via Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report) a press release dated October 29, 2026 confirming that US Customs and Border Protection released shipments of solar cells made at its Ethiopia facility after review of supply-chain traceability documentation covering polysilicon and wafer sourcing. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the Company is pursuing CTPAT certification and cites ongoing CVD and Section 232 risk. No special situation is present.
